payload.next_election_note: Norwich City Council does not publish a date for its next election on any page we could find, so we do not give one.
payload.summary: Norwich City Council has 39 councillors: three for each of the city's 13 wards. The Green Party holds 21 of those seats, Labour 12, the Liberal Democrats 3, Reform UK 2, and one councillor sits as an independent. The council's own leader and cabinet page shows that the leader of the council and all seven cabinet members are Green Party councillors.
